headline: Sabres’ Ryan McLeod, Louis Crevier healthy scratches Friday against Columbus
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, Ryan McLeod and Louis Crevier will be healthy scratches for Buffalo on Friday against Columbus, with Jiri Kulich and Conor Timmins expected to enter the lineup. NHL.com's Heather Engel posted that Timmins "will make his season debut tonight."

The numbers back the swap, at least on the forward side. McLeod has one goal and three points in 15 games so far this season, and the Sabres have controlled 48% of the quality of chances (expected goals, a measure of shot quality) at five-on-five with him on the ice. Kulich, the 28th pick in 2022, sits at 54% across eight games, and Buffalo's share rises about five points with him out there. Crevier's case is starker: 40% at five-on-five, and the team's share drops nearly 13 points with him on the ice. That is a small sample, but it is lopsided. Buffalo is 7-5-3 and sits at a dead-even 49% of expected goals overall, so any lineup tweak that nudges that share upward matters.
